message: だって女の子だもん

name: Synn
message: 「Hah... hah...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, you all right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huff... This is nothing」

name: Paqy
message: 「Studying for exams, doing patrols, training day and night. Looks like you've even been helping out at the shopping district every now and then」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Have I really been doing that much...?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah, you have! Because of all that, you haven't been getting any sleep lately, have ya?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, I am the Student Council President, after all... Besides, Re-Crea isn't going to wait just because we have exams...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, as long as you're fine, I guess... It'd all be for nothing if you wreck your body over it, ya know?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Demon Lord?」

name: Paqy
message: 「H-Hey! Demon Lord?! T-This is bad... Hey, snap out of it!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're just asleep?!」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Huh?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Oh, you're awake」

name: Synn
message: 「Gasp?!」
It's already gotten dark out!!

name: Paqy
message: 「You went and passed right out in the courtyard」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh... Did you carry me here, Paqy?」

name: Paqy
message: 「No matter how buff and strong I am, the heaviest thing I can lift is a pair of chopsticks」

name: Synn
message: 「What kind of sheltered young lady are you?!」

name: Paqy
message: 「That very young lady is the one who carried you」

name: Ria
message: 「I am not a sheltered girl!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Geez. Maybe I should've just left Synn-kun alone」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh-Wha!? Why are you here, Ria-senpai!?」

name: Ria
message: 「You don't have to look so surprised\s02」

name: Paqy
message: 「To spend a fun holiday with yours truly, obviously」

name: Ria
message: 「Yep, yep♪」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Whaaat--!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Having fun studying, that is」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... If it's naughty studying, I'm all for it anytime」

name: Ria
message: 「G-Geez, Paa-chan\s03 If you keep making jokes like that, I'm gonna pull your stuffing out」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hieeeee!! Anything but that」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai, why...」

name: Ria
message: 「When I got here, you were already fast asleep outside, Synn-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「Guh... So you saw me like that...」

name: Ria
message: 「No matter how nice the weather is, it gets cold right away once the sun goes down. If you sleep in a place like that, you'll catch a cold in no time, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Urgh」

name: Ria
message: 「Honestly... You're such a careless underclassman」

name: Synn
message: 「I have no excuse」

name: Ria
message: 「So, for a cute little underclassman like you, your senpai is going to give you some special care!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ehh!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahem. It's time for Ria-senpai's special lesson♪」
She smugly shows off a workbook.

name: Ria
message: 「As your senpai and the Student Council President, I have to take proper care of you, right\s04

name: Synn
message: 「Does that mean, Ria-senpai... you went out of your way because you were worried about me...」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey, now. Really, you shouldn't be making me worry in the first place, you know.」

name: Synn
message: 「Mgh... I'm always relying on you so much, Senpai...」

name: Ria
message: 「Ufufu, you really are a spoiled little guy♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Nnaaah!\s01」
I-I can't let Senpai see me looking any more uncool than this!

name: Synn
message: 「Aaalright. I'll do my best!」

name: Ria
message: 「Mm-hm, that's the spirit♪ Now then, shall we get started?」

name: Ria
message: 「You learned this formula back in your first year, right? You just apply that here.」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai... you sure remember it well...」

name: Ria
message: 「You think so?」

name: Synn
message: 「Even earlier, you remembered the second-year problems from last year too.」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmmmm. I just can't forget things, so it can't be helped.」
Only Ria-senpai could brush it off like that.

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, Senpai.」

name: Ria
message: 「Hm? Is there something you don't get?」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you for carrying me to my futon earlier.」

name: Ria
message: 「Not at all. That's only natural as your senior.」

name: Synn
message: 「I've never heard of a senior carrying a guy to bed, though.\s02」

name: Ria
message: 「Whaaat's this, Synn-kun? Were you hoping for something naughty or something?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Fuguooooh!」
Paqy faints after letting his imagination run wild on its own.

name: Synn
message: 「I-It's nothing like that...」

name: Ria
message: 「You're embarrassed, so even if you're thinking it, you won't say it out loud, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm not thinking it!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ufufu, it was just a joke, yet you turned all red.」

name: Synn
message: 「J-Jeez! You're always teasing me like that, Senpai.」
She's just like Helena-san when it comes to stuff like this.
I can't just keep letting her get the better of me, either. I want to turn the tables on her for once, but...
C-Can I actually pull it off... My heart's pounding.

name: Synn
message: 「Well then--」

name: Synn
message: 「If you're going to go that far, Senpai, then I-I-I'll...」

name: Ria
message: 「H-Huh!?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's your fault, Senpai... for making me feel this way...」

name: Ria
message: 「W-Wait a second, Synn-kun!? Wh-What are you--!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Even if I do this and that to you, I won't let you complain...」

name: Ria
message: 「N-No way!! Synn-kun, hold on, that's--」

name: Synn
message: 「Because you kept teasing me, Senpai...」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Uwooooh~~!」
I let out a huge breath with a 'puhah'. Even if it was just an act, that's so embarrassing~~\s01

name: Synn
message: 「J-Just kidding...」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun...」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm sorry... I didn't mean it like that, I... said something awful.」

name: Ria
message: 「You're... a boy too, after all, Synn-kun.」
And then, she gently pulls me into a hug.
A soft sensation against my face. Rea-senpai's warmth washes over me.

name: Ria
message: 「I'm sorry...」
Hearing her gentle whisper, I snap back to my senses all at once.

name: Synn
message: 「Ah!! Aaaah!! I-I'm sorry!! I'm so sorry!」

name: Ria
message: 「Haaah... That surprised me」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh... I'm sorry...」

name: Ria
message: 「Ufufu, you really are such a spoiled little thing♪」

name: Synn
message: 「I got carried away and did something weird...」

name: Ria
message: 「It's okay, I don't mind」
Wearing a mature smile, Ria-senpai shows her composure.

name: Ria
message: 「C-Come on, playtime's over♪ Let's do our best for the final stretch」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes!!」
I'm sorry, Ria-senpai.
I really shouldn't try doing things I'm not used to...
